ValidationRule.description: Increased cap required to close case for project increase cap and delta to cap
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Project__c , "Increase Cap"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Closed"), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Completed_Conversation_Exhausted__c , "Never Worked")), ISPICKVAL( Increased_Cap__c ,""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Increased Cap field required to close this Case.
